name: voice-session
title: Voice session
summary: A live voice call with an AI agent: a calm visual of who's speaking, a state label that morphs in place, a transcript where the agent's words appear as they're said and lookups show inline, mute, device and captions controls, and a summary of what was decided when you hang up. Covers a blocked or missing mic, slow connections, network drops and agent errors.
blurb: A live voice call with an AI agent, transcript included.
